name: Genesis Card
effect: Once, as your Basic Action, your partner Digimon immediately digivolves to the highest stage they have ever unlocked, ignoring the two-stages-above-Default limit and the once-per-round Digivolving Action limit, at no Hope cost. This lasts until the end of the encounter. For the first 2 rounds after this card is slashed, your partner Digimon also gains +2 to all hit and damage rolls.
